$comment: Machine-readable Valyd capability matrix for AI agents. Each entry maps a real integration goal to a stable id, its path, product, auth header, required credentials, whether it is billable, how PII is handled, whether a proof is saved to the user's Valyd account, and the agent-fetchable .md doc (root-relative; resolve against the docs host you fetched this file from). Hosted verification has TWO distinct modes with different data outcomes, so they are two entries (one_off vs account_connected). Every field is derived from the Agent Integration Guide (/ai/agent-guide) and llms.txt — nothing here is invented. Credentials cannot be minted by an agent; a human creates apps/keys in the Developer Portal.

capabilities.goal: Sign a user in and read their verified Valyd account (profile, licenses, verification proofs)
Read the proofs a signed-in user's account already holds (id_verified, age bands, licenses) — free, no check runs
capabilities.credential: the user's Bearer valyd_access_token (from Login with Valyd)

capabilities.goal: Run a verification for a signed-in user and save the passed proof to their Valyd ID; PII stays with Valyd. (ID/KYC in account mode is hosted-only — redirect via verify.kyc.redirectUrl.)
capabilities.credential: App X-API-Key + the user's valyd_access_token (attached to the check in the documented request field)

capabilities.goal: Run a one-off Direct API check on data you supply (incl. id-verification / kyc-credential); the full result including extracted identity fields returns to your system for you to store and protect
Send the user to Valyd's hosted capture page for a composed workflow WITHOUT a user token; the full combined result returns to your system on a signed webhook
Send a signed-in user to Valyd's hosted capture page WITH their valyd_access_token; passed proofs save to their Valyd ID and PII stays with Valyd (you receive the decision + proofs, not raw identity)
capabilities.credential: App X-API-Key + workflow_id + the user's valyd_access_token on the session

capabilities.goal: Onboard and control a workforce as organization members (face-activation, owner/admin/developer/member roles, per-seat billing); track who logged in via the valyd_org_member_id claim
capabilities.credential: client_id + client_secret (Login with Valyd) + Members API headers X-Client-Id / X-Client-Secret (server-side only)
